body: The Boeing 737 MAX 10 can touch down on a runway it cannot legally leave fully loaded, and the reason is built into the physics of landing and takeoff. An aircraft arrives much lighter than it departs, having burned thousands of pounds of fuel during the flight, and at its maximum structural landing weight the MAX 10 reportedly needs a landing distance of approximately 5,900 feet (1,800 meters) under standard atmospheric conditions, with thrust reversers, wheel brakes and spoilers bringing it to a stop. Taking off is far more demanding: at its maximum takeoff weight of 197,898 lb (89,765 kg), certified takeoff distances must account for an engine failure at the decision speed known as V1, with the runway long enough either to abort and stop nearly 99 tons of moving aircraft or to continue and climb out safely on a single engine. EUROCONTROL performance data cited in the report indicates a fully loaded MAX 10 requires roughly 8,860 feet (2,700 meters) to depart safely at maximum gross weight, a gap of nearly 2,960 feet (900 meters) over the landing distance.

Stretching the 737 to create the MAX 10 added a second, geometric problem. Boeing inserted a 40-inch (102 cm) fuselage plug forward of the wing and a 26-inch (66 cm) section behind it, making the aircraft 66 inches (1.68 meters) longer than the MAX 9 and seating up to 230 passengers, but the 737 family sits low to the ground, a heritage trait from its 1960s design, so the elongated tail greatly reduced ground clearance. With the standard landing gear of smaller MAX variants, the tail would strike the tarmac at normal rotation angles, and rotating more slowly and shallowly would have demanded even more runway. Boeing instead fitted a semi-levered main landing gear that extends by approximately 9.5 inches (24 cm) during rotation, pushing the wheels downward and rearward and shifting the rotation pivot point further back, giving the MAX 10 the same tail clearance angle as the shorter MAX 9 while still retracting into the standard 737 wheel well. The gear solved the tail-strike geometry, but it added no aerodynamic lift or engine thrust.

That unchanged lift and thrust is where the MAX 10 falls behind its main European rival. Boeing kept the standard MAX wing and CFM LEAP-1B engines, producing roughly 29,300 lbf (130 kN) of thrust per side, while the Airbus A321neo and A321XLR use a larger wing area, more sophisticated trailing-edge flap systems and CFM LEAP-1A or Pratt & Whitney PW1100G engines capable of over 33,000 lbf (147 kN) of thrust. The result is a noticeably weaker runway performance envelope at full capacity, felt most at hot-and-high airfields such as Denver International Airport, Albuquerque International Sunport and El Dorado International Airport in Bogota, where thin air reduces lift and thrust and summer heat lengthens takeoff rolls further. In daily service airlines are not banned from such airfields; dispatchers instead cap weight by offloading cargo, restricting fuel loads or blocking seats, and for operators such as United Airlines and Delta Air Lines this can mean choosing between fewer passengers and added fuel stops. The MAX 10 therefore works best as a high-density trunk liner on long, sea-level runways between major hubs such as Chicago O'Hare and London Heathrow, and battles physics wherever the runway is shorter or higher.
en.summary: The Boeing 737 MAX 10 needs far less runway to land than to depart at full weight, and its stretched fuselage adds tail-clearance limits that force weight caps at short or hot-and-high airports.
en.title: Why the Boeing 737 MAX 10 can land where it cannot depart fully loaded

body: 波音737MAX10可以在一條跑道上降落，卻無法從同一條跑道滿載起飛，原因就藏在降落與起飛的物理條件裡。飛機降落時比起飛時輕得多，因為飛行途中已經燒掉數千磅燃油；在最大結構降落重量下，737MAX10在標準大氣條件下的降落距離據報約為5900英尺（1800公尺），反推力裝置、機輪煞車與擾流板會讓飛機停下來。起飛的要求嚴格得多：在197898磅（89765公斤）的最大起飛重量下，認證起飛距離必須考慮發動機在決斷速度V1時失效的最壞情況，跑道必須夠長，讓將近99噸的飛機要嘛中斷起飛並完全停下，要嘛以單發動機繼續起飛並安全爬升。報導引用的EUROCONTROL性能資料指出，滿載的737MAX10在最大總重下安全起飛約需8860英尺（2700公尺），比降落距離多出將近2960英尺（900公尺）。

把737拉長成737MAX10還帶來第二個幾何問題。波音在機翼前方加裝40英寸（102公分）的機身段、在後方加裝26英寸（66公分）的機身段，使全長比737MAX9多66英寸（1.68公尺）、載客量達230人，但737家族自1960年代設計以來離地高度就很低，拉長的尾部大幅縮小了離地間隙。若沿用較小型737MAX的標準起落架，尾部會在正常抬輪角度下觸地；而以更慢、更平緩的角度抬輪，又需要更長的跑道。波音因此裝上半槓桿式主起落架，在抬輪階段伸長約9.5英寸（24公分），把機輪向下、向後推、使抬輪支點後移，讓737MAX10擁有與較短的737MAX9相同的尾部間隙角，同時仍可收進標準737輪艙。這套起落架解決了尾部觸地問題，卻沒有增加任何氣動升力或發動機推力。

升力與推力不變，正是737MAX10落後於歐洲主要對手的地方。波音沿用標準737MAX機翼與CFM LEAP-1B發動機，單側推力約29300磅力（130千牛頓）；空中巴士A321neo與A321XLR則採用較大的機翼面積、更精密的後緣襟翼系統，以及CFM LEAP-1A或普惠PW1100G發動機，推力超過33000磅力（147千牛頓）。結果是737MAX10在滿載時的跑道性能明顯較弱，在丹佛國際機場、阿布奎基國際機場與波哥大埃爾多拉多國際機場這類高溫高海拔機場感受最深，稀薄空氣會降低升力與推力，夏季高溫又進一步拉長起飛滑跑距離。日常營運中，航空公司並非被禁止飛往這類機場，而是由簽派員限制重量，方式包括卸下貨物、限制載油量或保留空座；對聯合航空與達美航空等業者而言，這意味著必須在減少載客與增加中停加油之間抉擇。因此737MAX10最適合擔任高密度幹線機型，飛往芝加哥歐海爾與倫敦希斯洛這類擁有長跑道的海平面樞紐機場；一旦跑道較短或海拔較高，就得與重量、溫度與高度的物理限制正面交鋒。
zh.summary: 波音737MAX10降落所需跑道遠短於滿載起飛所需跑道，加上機身拉長帶來的尾部間隙限制，使其在短跑道與高溫高海拔機場必須減載出發。
zh.title: 波音737MAX10為何能在部分機場降落、卻無法滿載起飛
